title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Right of Widow over the house of her husband. 3683 views Q. I have married in 1978 and divorce my wife through Islamic law and I have paid and settled ithath, meher and other expenses. And also we had a baby girl which was my daughter paid her incidential expenses till she passes minor category and above fixed Rupees Thirty thousand on fixed deposit for her marriage expenses till she comes the marriage age. I have taken her studies expenses time to time through bank which they have utilised it. This was agreed by both the parties and paid through Jamat meanwhile my X wife got married to other gentleman. About 5 years before my daughter got married and used the 18years fixed amount utilised for her marriage so I have not paid any further money, because the 18years fixed amount was very sufficient for all the marriage expenses. Now, four days before my daughter and her husband came and harrass me to give more and more and a huge amount or a property from me. For your kind information I do not own any property in my name. And my present wife own property on her names. Please guide me and let me know through shariyat legally does my daughter have any rights to get the demanding money? Because they have given me a warning that they can sue me by Indian Court. Please revert me back as soon as possible. 1700 views Q. How the property will be divided between one wife two sons n two daughters? 7802 views Q. Assalamlikum Provide me fatwa on my property distribution to my children. I have 4 sons & 2 married daughters. All property is in my name & my wife also alive. Property distribution in my life time as I knew divide the property into 6 equal parts and give each part to every one. But I want to distribute my property less or more (adjustment) way (not equally). Those (son or daughter) who is financially week or not good condition or other reasons etc.. I want to support them. Myself & my wife intention is very clear to look all children equally & wish all our children well settle & happy in the life without any discriminates or depriving in any son or daughter. Can I do like above it is correct under Islamic rules? And one more thing I want to know about GIFT GIVING RIGHT. Can I give gift some part to one son or daughter or other. Is it correct? 2674 views Q. 11th October 2010 / 2nd Zul Qadah 1431 Assalamou alaikum Respected Mufti sahib, I live in England, United Kingdom. I am a widow, my husband passed away nearly 3 months ago. I have 9 sons and 2 daughters. My husband?s mother is also alive. My late husband was the owner of two houses. Some months prior to his death, my husband made me a joint owner in one of these properties. Upon the instructions of my late husband, a solicitor completed the legal paperwork and we both signed various documents in the presence of witnesses. After the death of my husband, my children requested a scholar to explain the rules of Islamic inheritance so we could distribute my husband?s wealth according to the Shariah. When the discussion arose about the joint ownership of one of the houses, the scholar was of the opinion that this transfer of joint ownership was not valid because it seemed to him that this was only done symbolically and not as a genuine gift. However, beside the legal paperwork there is no other document available to support or negate the intention of the deceased. The scholar also said that even if the above gift was genuine, this kind of gift is faasid because of the following rule of Hiba: ومن وهب شقصاً مشاعاً فالهبة فاسدةٌ، فإن قسمه وسلمه جاز ) الهداية شرح بداية المبتدي,ص225,ج3, الناشر المكتبة الإسلامية) Which in essence says, if the item is such that if it is divided it can still be of use, then it is not permissible to give it without dividing it. Such items are ?a plot of land, a big house...?. See Bahishti Zewar (link below) page 66 point 5 http://www.islamicbulletin.org/free_downloads/women/bahishti_4_5_6_7.pdf I would be grateful if you would clarify (a) whether a house in the UK falls within the category of divisible property; (b) whether according to the Shariah I am the rightful owner of 50% of the house which was in joint ownership between myself and my husband. Jazakallah 2088 views Q. My father had one house given on rent. We are three brothers and four sisters [all married now]. When our own house was to construct, I spent huge amount on it 2385 views Q. Assalam o Alaikum wa rahmat ULLAH i wa Barakatuhu! Here is the problem that If the grand father of a person dies and his father is already dead. The grand son will recieve his part or not from grand father? If he recieves a part than what will be the ratio? If he has a property from his father , there is any part from his fathers property to other relatives like Uncle ( chacha ) etc or not? Please Give a comprehensive reply.. 2756 views Q. Who will be the legal heirs of a mentally ill sister? 3788 views Q. My marhoom father has left 1 property [ built house ].Please guide how to divide this property among MOTHER - TWO SONS - AND [1]ONE SON-IN-LAW of DEAD DAUGHTER as per SHARIYAT. 1854 views Q. inheritance 1361 views Q. Inheritance 1615 views Q. Am I obligated to give a share of my property to my son who married our former maid, despite my concerns about his wife's intentions? 1756 views Q. Janab Assalmwalekum, my father has purchased the following 1. An Agricultural land in my mothers name 2. A plot for house construction in his name but not constructed 3. A plot for house construction and house has been constructed in my, brothers and his(fathers)own name now my father and mother has been demised. we are three sisters and two brothers . now i would like to know that how can we distribute these properties as per islamic law. hope that you will answer me at the earliest possible and will keep confidential the question and answer. khuda Hafiz yours sincerely! 1605 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 14900 Country: Pakistan Title: assalamu alaikum muhtaram hazrat ji ,adaab,mera sawal ye hai k mery nana ne two shadiyan ki .first wife se aik daughter hai and doosri biwi se 5 children hain mery nana ne apni first wife ko house ka aik hissa likh ker de diya hai ,meri nani ne wo hissa apni daughter ko likh ker de diya hai. tu kiya iss main doosri biwi k children haqdar ho sakty hain k nahi .jazakallah. Question: assalamu alaikum muhtaram hazrat ji ,adaab,mera sawal ye hai k mery nana ne two shadiyan ki .first wife se aik daughter hai and doosri biwi se 5 children hain mery nana ne apni first wife ko house ka aik hissa likh ker de diya hai ,meri nani ne wo hissa apni daughter ko likh ker de diya hai. tu kiya iss main doosri biwi k children haqdar ho sakty hain k nahi .jazakallah. Answer ID: 14900 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1174/971=L/1430) If your maternal grandfather gifted a part of house to his first wife and gave it in her possession, she became the owner of the part and the children of the other wife will have no right in the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
